title: Pros and cons
description: Weigh advantages and drawbacks and reach a balanced conclusion.

introduction.headline: Weigh pros and cons
introduction.body: Practise balanced evaluation: state benefits, acknowledge drawbacks, and decide which side outweighs the other.
introduction.bodyIt: Pratica una valutazione equilibrata: indica i vantaggi, riconosci gli svantaggi e decidi quale lato prevale.
objectives: Use contrast markers such as however and overall

vocabulary.example: One benefit of the plan is lower cost.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Un vantaggio del piano è il costo inferiore.

vocabulary.example: The main drawback is limited contact with colleagues.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Lo svantaggio principale è il contatto limitato con i colleghi.

vocabulary.example: Overall, the policy has been successful.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Nel complesso, la politica ha avuto successo.

exercises.prompt: If benefits outweigh risks, what does that mean?
exercises.promptIt: Se i benefici outweigh i rischi, cosa significa?
options: The benefits are more important than the risks
The risks are more important than the benefits
The risks and benefits are equal
exercises.answer: The benefits are more important than the risks
exercises.explanation: Outweigh means to be more significant than something else.

exercises.prompt: One major ____ of remote work is weaker team bonding.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: One major ____ of remote work is weaker team bonding.
exercises.explanation: A drawback is a disadvantage or negative aspect.

exercises.prompt: Which word best introduces a balanced final judgement?
exercises.promptIt: Quale parola introduce meglio un giudizio finale equilibrato?
exercises.explanation: Overall summarises after considering different sides.

review.tip: Write three pros and two cons for a decision you face this week.
